mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are looking at a clear morning with temperatures at 59 degrees near City Hall under a waning crescent moon.

Stay informed on city operations. The City of Verona maintains a partnership with AECOM Inc. for engineering services with regular reporting. Also, the Senior Center is currently offering free tri-shaw bike rides along the Military Ridge State Trail for those who register.

There is a lot to do this weekend, including live music at Bailey's Run happening today and a Girls Try Hockey event also happening today at the Verona Ice Arena. Looking ahead, you can join a yoga session tomorrow at Insight Wellness.
The Verona Police Department released their weekly summary, noting that on July 31st, a traffic stop led to an arrest for O W I and additional citations for a suspended registration.
Culver's is currently closed but will open at 10 AM. Today's flavor is Snickers Swirl, and if you miss out, tomorrow features Georgia Peach.
